title: DECISION: SOS int-token coordinates accepted at Python app layer, rejected by C/Rust wire codec
description: RR3-SOS-1: python emergency.py CheckInResource accepts integer lat/lon (SenML permits numeric ints; LCI app-layer convenience, documented + tested) while C/Rust wire codecs require float tokens. Orchestrator ruling: legitimate layering divergence — AGENTS.md identical-output mandate applies to canonical test vectors (all float tokens, pass on all three impls), not to app-resource input convenience. Divergence documented in emergency.py docstring. Reopen if spec/12-apps SOS section later defines wire-level int admission.
close_reason: Ruled intentional layering: app-resource int acceptance is SenML-conformant convenience; wire codecs stay float-only; canonical vectors float-only and triple-green. Documented in emergency.py docstring.
